title: RMA: Context-Orchestrated Research Math Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.22875v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-horizon mathematical reasoning fails less often because a model cannot produce a valid next step than because an agent fails to maintain and expose the right semantic state across many iterations. Left unmanaged, this produces research-level proofs that are locally convincing yet globally incomplete: a key lemma unproved, an assumption unchecked, a citation unsupported, or a computational claim unverified. We present Research Math Agents (RMA), an agentic framework for long-horizon proof development built around a persistent, typed research store and an orchestrator that compiles operation-specific context from that store. translated_title: RMA：上下文编排的研究型数学智能体
translated_abstract: 长程数学推理的失败，往往不是因为模型无法产生有效的下一步，而是因为智能体在多次迭代中未能维持并暴露正确的语义状态。若不加管理，这会导致研究级证明局部看似可信、全局却不完整：关键引理未被证明、假设未被检验、引用缺乏支撑，或计算性结论未经核实。我们提出了研究型数学智能体（RMA），这是一个面向长程证明开发的智能体框架，其核心是一个持久的、带类型的研究存储库，以及一个从该存储库编译特定操作上下文的编排器。研究上下文编排器（Research Context Orchestrator）是持久研究存储库与每个局部作用域证明操作之间的核心状态管理层：它检索与任务相关的制品，将其编译为有界上下文，调用相应的操作，并写回由此产生的证明编辑与问题更新。
tldr: RMA 提出了一个面向长程数学证明开发的智能体框架，通过持久化类型化研究存储库与上下文编排器来维护正确的语义状态，从而避免研究级证明出现局部可信但全局不完整的问题。
en_tdlr: RMA is an agentic framework for long-horizon mathematical proof development that maintains the right semantic state across iterations via a persistent typed research store and a context orchestrator, preventing research-level proofs from being locally convincing yet globally incomplete.
